logline: The Dowager Duchess realizes Juliana's wedding ring bears the Ashbourne crest belonging to her lost son, but before Juliana can reveal Alexander's name, Rupert and Catherine storm the bedchamber and frame her for poisoning the Duchess.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 26's cliffhanger where the Dowager Duchess gripped Juliana's hand upon recognizing the family signet ring, frantically questioning her origin.

scenes.heading: INT. ASHBURG MANOR - DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of the Dowager Duchess's aged, trembling hands clutching Juliana's hand, examining the worn metal band on her finger.

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Shaken, Breathless)
events.content: "This ring..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped against her pillows, gripping Juliana's wrist firmly as she gazes up in desperate demand.

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Urgent, Demanding)
events.content: "Look at me, girl. Who gave this to you?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana in her maid's apron, startled and anxious as she answers.

events.label: JULIANA (Hesitant, Sincere)
events.content: "My husband. He gave it to me when we wed."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low angle on the Dowager Duchess, her eyes burning with intensity.

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Incredulous, Intense)
events.content: "He is no commoner. What does he do?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana, trying to keep her composure.

events.label: JULIANA (Earnest, Defending)
events.content: "He is a soldier. A veteran from the Peninsula."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot as the Duchess leans forward slightly, staring at the ring between their joined hands.

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Revelatory)
events.content: "That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Juliana, shaking her head in disbelief and growing confusion.

events.label: JULIANA (Confused, Gentle)
events.content: "No. He lives in a barn. He has nothing but his word."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle shot on the Duchess, tears welling in her eyes as grief and shock overtake her.

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Emotionally Strained, Weeping)
events.content: "My lost son wore that exact ring. He went to war..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in stunned revelation.

events.label: JULIANA (Shocked, Breathless)
events.content: "Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Side-angle medium shot of the bed, the Duchess holding onto Juliana's forearm with fierce insistence.

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Desperate, Clinging)
events.content: "My lost son wore that ring!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana looking down with compassionate concern.

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (O.S.) (Pleading)
events.content: "Did your husband serve beside him?"

events.label: JULIANA (Soft, Reverent)
events.content: "He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Duchess gazing up at Juliana, her voice barely a whisper.

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Hushed, Desperate)
events.content: "What is your husband's name?"

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Loud, violent pounding echoes on the wooden double doors.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Juliana gasps, snapping her head toward the entrance in alarm.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The heavy mahogany double doors burst open, revealing the Blond Nobleman flanked by Lady Catherine and a royal guard in uniform.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot framing the open doorway as the aristocrats step into the dimly lit hallway.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Lady Catherine in her lavish cream gown and tiara, scowling with arrogant disdain.

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Sharp, Accusatory)
events.content: "What is that maid doing in Her Grace's private chamber?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana standing stiffly beside the bed, concealing her hands.

events.label: JULIANA (Calm, Defiant)
events.content: "She needed help."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Lady Catherine narrowing her eyes with venomous suspicion.

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Piercing, Suspicious)
events.content: "What are you hiding?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana, her chin raised.

events.label: JULIANA (Firm)
events.content: "Nothing."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Lady Catherine pointing a white-gloved finger directly at Juliana.

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Demanding, Harsh)
events.content: "Show me your hand."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman stepping forward beside Lady Catherine, clad in a dark tailored coat with black leather gloves.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Authoritative)
events.content: "Girl. Show me what you are holding."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Two-shot of Juliana facing the Blond Nobleman as she slowly extends her palm, revealing the small amber glass dropper bottle.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Skeptical)
events.content: "What is this?"

events.label: JULIANA (Steady)
events.content: "Medicine."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Lady Catherine tapping her gloved finger to her lip, letting out a mocking scoff.

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Mocking, Condescending)
events.content: "Medicine? You are a new maid."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman staring down at the vial, as Catherine sneers from his side.

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Incredulous, Accusing)
events.content: "Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana holding her ground.

events.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Resolute)
events.content: "No one."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Lady Catherine turning fiercely triumphant.

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Spiteful, Indignant)
events.content: "Then you administered it without permission."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana, her voice rising passionately.

events.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Urgent)
events.content: "Because she was dying!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman pacing forward with calculating malice.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Interrogating)
events.content: "And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana retorting without hesitation.

events.label: JULIANA (Fierce)
events.content: "The physicians were not saving her!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Over-the-shoulder shot past the Blond Nobleman looking toward the frail Duchess watching helplessly from the bed.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Measured, Menacing)
events.content: "My aunt has been wasting away for months."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the Blond Nobleman turning slowly back toward Juliana, building his trap.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Smooth, Threatening)
events.content: "And now we find an unknown maid alone beside her bed..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up shot of his gloved black leather finger reaching down to tap against the glass dropper bottle in Juliana's open palm.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Contemptuous)
events.content: "...holding a substance no one authorized her to give."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana raising the small bottle high for them to see.

events.label: JULIANA (Unyielding)
events.content: "It is an antidote."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Lady Catherine sneering sharply.

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Sharp, Provocative)
events.content: "An antidote to what?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of Juliana's focused eyes.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Stern, Barked)
events.content: "Answer her."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on the Blond Nobleman's impatient scowl.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana speaking the truth clearly.

events.label: JULIANA (Unyielding, Resolute)
events.content: "Poison."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on the Blond Nobleman, his expression freezing into a dark scowl.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Whispering, Dangerous)
events.content: "Poison."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana stating the grim reality.

events.label: JULIANA (Urgent)
events.content: "Someone has been poisoning Her Grace."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Lady Catherine turning abruptly to the guard stationed by the open door, pointing with feigned outrage.

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Shrieking, Feigning Horror)
events.content: "You hear that?!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Lady Catherine twisting Juliana's words with malicious glee.

events.label: LADY CATHERINE (Venomous, Accusing)
events.content: "She admits she has been giving the Duchess poison in secret!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana recoiling in shock at the blatant lie.

events.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Outraged)
events.content: "That is not what I said!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman raising his black-gloved hand, silencing the room.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Authoritative, Icy)
events.content: "Enough."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot as the Blond Nobleman steps into Juliana's personal space and plucks the glass dropper vial from her hand.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Blond Nobleman takes the medicine vial from Juliana's grasp, inspecting it under the candlelight.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Calculating)
events.content: "An unknown servant enters a restricted chamber."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of the Blond Nobleman holding the vial beside his temple, his blue eyes cold and triumphant.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Condemning, Vindictive)
events.content: "She secretly administers an unidentified substance to a helpless woman."

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (To Guard, Stern)
events.content: "Take her."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot as the armed guard storms forward, seizing Juliana roughly by both arms.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The guard twists Juliana around and drags her forcibly toward the doorway as she struggles against his grip.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana being pulled backward, casting a frantic glance back toward the bedridden Duchess.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, terrified eyes as she realizes the deadly trap closing around her, cutting abruptly to black.
